  cp "$SCRIPT_DIR/terminal/sequences.txt" "$STATE_DIR"/user/generated/terminal/sequences.txt
  # Apply colors
  for i in "${!colorlist[@]}"; do
    sed -i "s/${colorlist[$i]} #/${colorvalues[$i]#\#}/g" "$STATE_DIR"/user/generated/terminal/sequences.txt
  done

  sed -i "s/\$alpha/$term_alpha/g" "$STATE_DIR/user/generated/terminal/sequences.txt"

      {
      cat "$STATE_DIR"/user/generated/terminal/sequences.txt >"$file"
      } & disown || true

[ -f "$HOME/.bashrc.env" ] && . "$HOME/.bashrc.env"

# ── re-entry guard (a login shell that already sourced us must not repeat) ──
if [ -n "${__BASHRC_LOADED:-}" ]; then return 0 2>/dev/null || exit 0; fi
__BASHRC_LOADED=1

# ── interactive guard ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
[[ $- != *i* ]] && return

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  INTERACTIVE-ONLY
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ── history ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
HISTCONTROL=ignoreboth:erasedups
HISTSIZE=200000 HISTFILESIZE=500000
HISTTIMEFORMAT='%F %T '
shopt -s histappend cmdhist checkwinsize globstar nocaseglob cdspell dirspell dotglob extglob no_empty_cmd_completion

# ── real-bash check (drives color exports below) ─────────────────────────
if [ -n "${BASH_VERSION:-}" ] && { [ "${BASH:-}" = "/usr/bin/bash" ] || [ "${BASH:-}" = "/bin/bash" ]; }; then
  __RB=1; else __RB=0
fi

# ── zoxide ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
command -v zoxide >/dev/null 2>&1 && eval "$(zoxide init bash --cmd cd)"

# ── completions ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if ! shopt -oq posix; then
  [ -f /usr/share/bash-completion/bash_completion ] && . /usr/share/bash-completion/bash_completion
  for d in "$HOME/.bash_completion.d" "$HOME/.local/share/bash-completion/completions"; do
    [ -d "$d" ] && for f in "$d"/*; do [ -r "$f" ] && . "$f"; done
  done
fi

# ── starship ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
command -v starship >/dev/null 2>&1 && eval "$(starship init bash)"

# ── other tool hooks ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
command -v direnv >/dev/null 2>&1 && eval "$(direnv hook bash)"
command -v atuin  >/dev/null 2>&1 && eval "$(atuin init bash --disable-up-arrow --disable-ctrl-r)"

# mise (idempotent: skip if shims already on PATH; .bashrc may be sourced
# multiple times via .bash_profile and .profile)
if command -v mise >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  case ":$PATH:" in
    *":$HOME/.local/share/mise/shims:"*) ;;
    *) eval "$(mise activate bash --shims)" ;;
  esac
fi

# ── nvm ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Must come after mise (which can prepend shims) and before fzf/ble.sh.
# ble.sh (sourced from ~/.bashrc.local) snapshots PATH — it must see nvm's
# bin on PATH or nvm completion breaks.
export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"
[ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"
[ -s "$NVM_DIR/bash_completion" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/bash_completion"

# ── fzf ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if command -v fzf >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  [ -f /usr/share/fzf/key-bindings.bash ] && . /usr/share/fzf/key-bindings.bash
  [ -f /usr/share/fzf/completion.bash ] && . /usr/share/fzf/completion.bash
  export FZF_DEFAULT_OPTS='--height 40% --layout=reverse --border --inline-info'
  command -v fd >/dev/null 2>&1 && export FZF_DEFAULT_COMMAND='fd --type f --hidden --exclude .git' FZF_CTRL_T_COMMAND="$FZF_DEFAULT_COMMAND"
fi

# ── colors (env-var driven, no self-referential aliases) ────────────────
if [ "$__RB" = 1 ]; then
  export GCC_COLORS='error=01;31:warning=01;35:note=01;36:caret=01;32:locus=01:quote=01'
  export GREP_COLORS='ms=01;31:mc=01;31:sl=:cx=:fn=35:ln=32:bn=32:se=36'
  export CLICOLOR=1
  unset CLICOLOR_FORCE
  export LESS_TERMCAP_mb=$'\e[01;31m' LESS_TERMCAP_md=$'\e[01;31m' LESS_TERMCAP_me=$'\e[0m'
  export LESS_TERMCAP_se=$'\e[0m' LESS_TERMCAP_so=$'\e[01;44;33m' LESS_TERMCAP_ue=$'\e[0m' LESS_TERMCAP_us=$'\e[01;32m'
fi

# ── aliases ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
alias ls='ls --color=auto --group-directories-first'
alias ll='ls -alFh'; alias la='ls -A'; alias l='ls -CF'; alias lt='ls -alFht'
alias ..='cd ..'; alias ...='cd ../..'; alias ....='cd ../../..'
alias tau="$HOME/.local/bin/tau"
alias omp='tau'; alias pi='tau'
alias p='pass'; alias py='python3'; alias k9='kubectl'; alias d='docker'; alias dc='docker compose'
alias rm='rm -I --preserve-root'; alias cp='cp -i'; alias mv='mv -i'; alias mkdir='mkdir -p'
alias pf="$HOME/.local/bin/pitchfork-quiet" 2>/dev/null || true
# ffs: first-class finder (replaces fd/rg for agents; v0.1.30+)
# ffs aliases/shims defined in .bashrc.env (find, grep, ff, ffa, etc.)

# ── functions ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
mkcd() { mkdir -p -- "$1" && cd -- "$1"; }

extract() {
  case "$1" in
    *.tar.bz2) tar xjf "$1";; *.tar.gz) tar xzf "$1";; *.tar.xz) tar xJf "$1";;
    *.tar.zst) tar --zstd -xf "$1";; *.bz2) bunzip2 "$1";; *.gz) gunzip "$1";;
    *.tar) tar xf "$1";; *.zip) unzip "$1";; *.7z) 7z x "$1";;
    *) printf 'unknown archive: %s\n' "$1";;
  esac
}

doctor() {
  printf '── shell ──\n'
  printf '  BASH=%s  VER=%s  flags=%s\n' "$BASH" "$BASH_VERSION" "$-"
  printf '  BASH_ENV=%s  OMP_SHELL_PATH=%s\n' "${BASH_ENV:-unset}" "${OMP_SHELL_PATH:-unset}"
  printf '  stdin TTY=%s  stdout TTY=%s\n' "$([ -t 0 ] && printf yes || printf no)" "$([ -t 1 ] && printf yes || printf no)"
  printf '── binaries ──\n'
  for b in tau omp pi bun cargo uv mise rg fd ffs starship zoxide atuin direnv fzf node npm nvm; do
    p=$(command -v "$b" 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$p" ] && printf '  %-10s MISSING\n' "$b" || printf '  %-10s %s\n' "$b" "$p"
  done
  printf '── PATH (first 10) ──\n'; printf '%s\n' "$PATH" | tr ':' '\n' | head -10 | nl -ba | sed 's/^/  /'
  printf '── dupes ──\n'; d=$(printf '%s\n' "$PATH" | tr ':' '\n' | sort | uniq -d); [ -z "$d" ] && printf '  none\n' || printf '%s\n' "$d" | sed 's/^/  /'
}

unset __RB

# CONTEXT7_API_KEY lives in ~/.secrets (0600) — never a literal in this file.
# (moved 2026-09-21 by ember-monkeyfix; was a literal export above)
if [ -f "$HOME/.secrets" ]; then
  _c7k=$(/usr/bin/grep -E '^(export )?CONTEXT7_API_KEY=' "$HOME/.secrets" | head -1)
  _c7k=${_c7k#export }
  _c7k=${_c7k#CONTEXT7_API_KEY=}
  [ -n "$_c7k" ] && export CONTEXT7_API_KEY="$_c7k"
  unset _c7k
fi

# 2026-09-21 ember-monkeyfix: REMOVED direnv auto-allow hook (was auto-allowing
# arbitrary .envrc files = arbitrary code exec on cd). Allow per-dir manually:
#   direnv allow /path/to/.envrc
export _ZO_DOCTOR=0

# ── WezTerm shell integration (OSC 133 semantic prompt markers) ──
if [ "${TERM_PROGRAM:-}" = "WezTerm" ] && command -v wezterm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  [ -f "$HOME/.config/wezterm/shell-integration.sh" ] && . "$HOME/.config/wezterm/shell-integration.sh"
fi

# ble.sh loads here (via .bashrc.local). Must be last — it snapshots
# PATH, prompt, and completion state, so nvm/mise/fzf must already be set up.
[ -f ~/.bashrc.local ] && source ~/.bashrc.local

**Date:** 2026-09-15 ~03:30 UTC · **Box:** awrawr-pc (Arch/CachyOS) · **Terminal:** WezTerm 20260622-120102-6ff54928 (nightly)

**Root cause (two stacked defects):**
- (a) The sed substitution pattern is `${colorlist[$i]} #` (i.e. `"$term0␣#"`) but the template placeholders are `#$term0`. **Evidence:** `evidence/applycolor-apply_anyterm.txt` (function excerpt), `evidence/sequences-template-vs-generated.txt` (template vs generated, both showing unsubstituted `#$term0`).

**Proposed patch (NOT applied):**
1. Fix the placeholder syntax — match `#$name`, not `$name␣#`.
